text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Great work today!
That was another awesome live show, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about that concert earlier,
I wonder if my being here is just a nuisance..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh?! That's not true at all!
In fact, I'm just super grateful you joined us!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal is a concert where everyone sings together!
There's no one whose presence would ever be a burden!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! And you have yet to obtain it.
...The answer to that matter, as well.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Besides, more and more girls are offering to lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait... That's.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-chan!
You came again this time!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. In order to resolve the error.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: An error...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Normally, the act of watching a live performance
serves no purpose other than as a dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have determined that I first require
training to secure a victory in the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "However, my brain processed that 'I should come here.' Cause of error: unknown."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Based on the above, I request permission to ask a "question."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, yeah.
Go ahead with your question."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The date of the error's occurrence was the day
I watched your live performance for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, did you do
something to me that day?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...On that day, you see, I sang.
With all my heart and soul. Asking them to sing with me."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that's why Bourbon-chan
wanted to sing too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Me, singing...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm sure Bourbon-chan just wanted to
convey her feelings to someone with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Bourbon-chan. Want to do our best
together for the Grand Live?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that error is just your heart
trying to speak up, Bourbon-chan... So, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "...Does that mean by 'singing' it, you will be able to understand the details?"
The song from that day had undeniably and deeply stirred Mihono Bourbon's heart—
